title: Cross-Lingual Stability and Bias in Instruction-Tuned Language Models for Humanitarian NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prompt-language bias by translating task instructions into seven different languages while keeping the underlying dataset text unchanged, and measuring cross-lingual variations in model classifications using metrics like Calibration Deviation (CD), Decision Bias (ΔBias), Language Robustness Score (LRS), and Language Stability Score (LSS).
